result.rationale: In sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns `const response = await fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` — a fetch Response. Google caller does `const token = res?.data;` then `token.access_token` (Response has no `.data`), and Bigin/ZohoCRM callers do `tokenInfo.data.error` / `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`, which throws TypeError since `.data` is undefined on a Response. Verified in diff.
